Bash(sqlite3 kb.sqlite "SELECT MIN\(created_at\), MAX\(created_at\) FROM nodes WHERE l0_summary LIKE '%占位%' OR l0_summary LIKE '%lorem%' OR l0_summary LIKE '%sample note%' OR l0_summary LIKE '%间隔重复学习研究%' OR l0_summary LIKE '%酸面团面包%' OR l0_summary LIKE '%sleep architecture and memory%';")
